instruction: Candid cinematic medium shot of an indoor party. On the left, the light-brown-haired man in a checkered shirt under a green t-shirt (R2) looks toward his friend. On the right, the dark-haired man in a green t-shirt (R1) tilts his head far back, holding an empty red cup upside down over his open mouth. They stand side-by-side behind a table of red cups. Dim indoor lighting with blue and warm tones.
elements: R1 tilts his head far back with his mouth open while holding an empty red cup upside down over his mouth
R2 looks toward R1 as the observing friend rather than performing the cup-over-mouth action
R1 handles the empty red cup while R2 stands beside him without taking that drinking role
empty red cup held upside down over R1's open mouth
table of red cups in front of the two men
